verdicts.reason: A properly reflows the poster for the banner: a large, legible headline on the left in three clean lines and the cat group as a bold right-hand focal point. Its flaws are minor: the cats float with a purple strip beneath them instead of bleeding off the bottom edge as in the original, and the text block sits slightly high relative to the art. B is just a shrunk, centred copy of the portrait layout: the headline is tiny and weak for the format, the cat cluster is small, and wide dead purple areas fill both sides, so it doesn't use the banner shape at all.
